items.issue: Precise source-backed district identities absent from current reader registry need River registration and membership/geometry integration; never substitute countywide or whole-school scope.
Exact Minneapolis SSD 1 board districts 1, 3 and 5 and Elk River ISD 728 board district 2 confirmed by official public selector and actual sample. Subdistrict polygons were not acquired.

Chanhassen citywide fields confirmed by an actual Carver County-side city sample and final general roster. SOS precinct geometry confirms Hennepin city territory; no Hennepin-side selector range was located. The canonical whole-city electorate is retained.

51 selected actual sample PDFs cover every identified final-roster local candidate field, rather than every Hennepin precinct/school split. Additional measures, style-specific administrative instructions and separately declared write-ins are outside this candidate packet.

ISD 728 school board District 1 is not shown for the sampled Hennepin voters; only its at-large and District 2 fields are included. Aitkin ISD 1 is distinct from Minneapolis SSD 1. Adjacent school-boundary slivers are not treated as Hennepin voter eligibility.

County elections and county tax school report endpoints returned 403. Official statewide general files, anonymous ballot API, actual PDF samples and official state GIS supplied the verified coverage; failures are not represented as successful sources.
